CustomField.label: Austritt
CustomField.description: SCRUM-453: True, wenn der Contact person no longer works at the customer's company. Row-level mark, never deletes the record. Setting it is Sales/Service (SCRUM453_ContactLeft_Set); clearing it only for team leads (SCRUM453_ContactLeft_Undo, enforced by ContactLeftGuardTrigger). Commercially sensitive business data, not PII.
